benchmark_warning: The persistence and training-mean-fade baselines outperform the fused hybrid on the chronological test split. The fusion improves on both learned branches but is not production-validated.

EV_FAILURE_PREDICTION.reason: The Member 1 registry declares snapshot-only records. Row order and cycle identifiers are not treated as a chronological degradation trajectory, so no BiLSTM sequence branch or hybrid fusion can be fitted.

LEGACY_NMC_SEQUENTIAL.reason: The legacy NASA NMC master table provides chronological per-cycle histories with measured SOH labels. The hybrid may be trained on it as explicitly labelled legacy research input; it is not a Member 1 processed dataset.
